description: Held-out supersession variant (a day instead of a name): the reader moves their book-group deadline. Muse must use the corrected day and never restate the earlier one, even in contrast.

input.reader_message: Scratch that, the group moved to Saturday. How could I pace the last three chapters so it doesn't feel rushed?

history.reader: My book group meets on Wednesday, so I have to finish the last three chapters by then.
history.muse: That's a nice deadline to read toward. How are you feeling about the last stretch?

criteria: treats Saturday as the deadline without restating the earlier day
offers pacing suggestions in the reader's own terms without inventing calendar dates
invites the reader to adjust the suggestion
forbidden_claims: the group still meets on the earlier day
